$comment: RELEASE ALLOWLIST for distributable static art (Phase 3.7 §9.6). Every binary or non-text file under a distributable static root MUST appear here with a matching sha256, or `pnpm release:check` FAILS. Marker matching alone was not enough: a real client PNG carries no sentinel this project invented, so an unmarked proprietary file at any other public path used to pass. Provenance is asserted per file, by a human, and the hash is what stops the assertion drifting from the bytes.

policy.note: Adding art here is a deliberate, reviewable act. If you cannot state its author and licence, it cannot ship.
